steps.title: Unit 1 — Printed letters
steps.body: This is a proposed Lesson 1 mapping, not an approved owned-edition alignment. The development unit teaches printed letter identities with public-domain letter forms. Example words and model audio are not part of this unit. Qualified review is still pending.
steps.bookDirection: Open your copy to Lesson 1. Use the book for the author's explanations, exercises, and any example words.

steps.title: Identify letters first
steps.body: Work letter shapes, print pairs, and Latin look-alikes before later reading. Transliteration, if you use it, is a temporary support.

steps.title: Cyrillic is a different alphabet
steps.body: Russian is written with 33 Cyrillic letters. Some printed shapes look like Latin letters and are not the same letters. Learn identity first.

steps.title: First vowel set
steps.body: Work these printed pairs: А а, О о, У у, Э э, Ы ы, И и. English sound notes are pending qualified review.

steps.title: Identify А
steps.body: Choose the Cyrillic identity for the printed letter.

steps.title: Low-confusion consonants
steps.body: Next printed pairs: М м, Т т, К к, П п, Б б, Д д, Г г. Confirm each spoken sound in your book. This unit does not play model audio.

steps.title: Identify М
steps.body: Choose the Cyrillic identity for the printed letter.

steps.title: Shape traps
steps.body: These printed letters often fool Latin-alphabet readers: В, Н, Р, С, У, Х. Name the Cyrillic identity.

steps.title: Recognize admitted noun genders
steps.body: The frozen grammar page says Russian groups nouns as masculine, feminine, and neuter, and that an ending cue is not enough for every noun. Use the gender on the admitted record. стол — masculine, table, desk, board; diet, cooking, cuisine; department, section. дом — masculine, house, home, house-hold. го́род — masculine, town. брат — masculine, brother. учи́тель — masculine, teacher, tutor. хлеб — masculine, bread, loaf, corn, crops, cereals, grain, living, means of subsistence, daily bread. чай — masculine, tea, tea-party, methinks, maybe. друг — masculine, friend. кни́га — feminine, book, volume. вода́ — feminine, water. шко́ла — feminine, school, schoolhouse. рабо́та — feminine, work, working, job. ма́ма — feminine, mom, mama, mommy, mummy. же́нщина — feminine, woman, women, womanfolk, womankind. семья́ — feminine, family. дверь — feminine, door. окно́ — neuter, window, casement-window, window-sill, gap, opening, port, slot, free period, break. письмо́ — neuter, letter, writing, script. молоко́ — neuter, milk. мо́ре — neuter, sea, ocean. ме́сто — neuter, place, spot, site, locality; region, area; site, scene; room, space; job, position; piece of luggage. сло́во — neuter, word; speech. мужчи́на — masculine, man. дя́дя — masculine, uncle, Mister, man, fellow. Adjective agreement and past-tense endings are outside this unit.

steps.title: Recognize admitted question words and written questions
steps.body: The frozen interrogative page supplies these question words and written questions. Intonation is not taught because no exact licensed audio is matched. Кто — Who. Что — What. Когда — When. Почему — Why. Как — How. Где — Where (location). Куда — Whither, where to. Откуда — Whence, where from. Сколько — How much, how many. Какой — What kind. Written examples: Что это? — What is this?. Кто это? — Who is this?. Как дела? — How do you do?/How're things?. Где вы живёте? — Where do you live?. Куда вы идёте? — Where are you walking to?. Почему он не знает? — Why doesn't he know?. Какой сыр? — What kind of cheese?.

steps.title: Recognize admitted prepositional examples

Он в театре — He is at the theatre. Ваза стоит на столе. — The vase stands on the table.. Картина висит на стене. — The painting hangs on the wall..
